headword: ありがとうございます
reading: ありがとうございます

definitions.explanation: Polite expression of gratitude, used in formal situations and toward those of higher status.

examples.japanese: {格別|かくべつ}のご{配慮|はいりょ}をいただき、ありがとうございます。
examples.english: Thank you for your special consideration.

examples.japanese: {教|おし}えてくださり、ありがとうございます。
お{忙|いそが}しい{中|なか}、ありがとうございます。
examples.english: Thank you for your time despite being busy.

notes:
ありがとうございます is the polite form of "thank you."

POLITENESS LEVELS:
- ありがとう: casual/plain
- ありがとうございます: polite (present)
- ありがとうございました: polite (past/completed action)
- {誠|まこと}にありがとうございます: very formal

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～てくださり、ありがとうございます: thank you for doing ~
- ～いただき、ありがとうございます: thank you for doing ~ (humble)
- いつもありがとうございます: thank you as always
- {本当|ほんとう}にありがとうございます: thank you very much

WHEN TO USE PAST FORM:
- Use ありがとうございました when:
  - Thanking after receiving something
  - The situation has concluded
  - At the end of an interaction

ETYMOLOGY:
From {有|あ}り{難|がた}い (rare/precious) + ございます (polite existence). Literally "it is a precious/rare thing."
